name: Virginia 4-H
org: Virginia Cooperative Extension (Virginia Tech and Virginia State University)
city: Statewide, Virginia (a local Extension office in each area)
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club, camp or project and learn by doing. Leadership, citizenship and life skills are taught through projects, camps, and county, state and national events.
who_can_apply: 4-H participants are youth ages 5 to 19. Community 4-H clubs are for ages 9 through 18. You join by contacting your local Virginia Cooperative Extension office.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the page read. Ask your local Extension office.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs, camps and events set their own dates.
how_to_apply: Contact your local Virginia Cooperative Extension office and ask about the 4-H program.
notes: The page also lists a 4-H State Congress, camps, maker education, shooting education and youth leadership opportunities. Details such as dates and fees for those were not on the page read.
